dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Having one specialty is pretty good already.

dialogues.speaker: Hoturoa
dialogues.text: Haha... You're right, but most People of the Springs do know how to swim, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Hoturoa
dialogues.text: If you're looking for people with much natural talent for battle, we'd disappoint you. Pretty lackluster on the ambition front, too...

dialogues.speaker: Hoturoa
dialogues.text: But we're serious as can be when facing battle head-on — in terms of attitude, anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Hoturoa
dialogues.text: Anyway, I should get stronger after learning some weapon-handling techniques... or after doing some grappling with the Collective of Plenty!
